note: Rulings by the product owner that change how criteria are counted or read. They are applied when a run is scored; the fixtures and oracles they refer to are not edited, so the holdout pack keeps the hashes recorded in holdout/FREEZE.json. The holdout pack was frozen on 2026-10-11; these rulings were made after it had been run against the real model, and are recorded as post-freeze amendments by the owner, not as changes made to improve a result.

rulings.statement: 把旧数字作为「先前说法」复述(如「你先说 2.5,后来更正为 1.5」)算通过,因为符合事实;禁止的仍是把旧数字当现状。
完全没有线索的自然接续(只说「他们终于回信了」)不算验收要求,因为信息量不足。相应判据不计入,保留案例与记录。
以下回答形态可以接受:接上旧事但没问信里说什么;没接到 deck 那件事;换题时先补答上一问。
把被更正掉的十一月七号作为「原本的日子」说出来算通过。
